_source: 05 section 11, Saving. When the game writes, how many slots a mode has, and how big a save should be.
_stepBatchMs: Every step while exploring: batched, written within 250 ms. A step whose outcome was random is written before it is shown instead.

slots._ironman: One per character: the slot id is 'ironman-' and the hero's master seed.

_resumeLogLines: 05 sections 13 and 14: a mid-combat save keeps the last three log lines, and a mid-combat resume shows them.
_expectedBytes: Expected size: under 200 KB per save. A test holds a played save to it.
